propositions: When a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory is enumerated by hand or incompletely rather than derived from the symbol graph, a plan-review criterion should detect this and coach re-derivation with find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweep
Code-review moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is needed for the corrective coaching half

A project.* criterion id can never fire a code-review move because applies_when tags are drawn from a closed vocabulary, making such moves permanently dead; the criterion must route to plan_review only
The new project.symbol-reference-completeness criterion must be advisory via default_posture without inert blocking_enabled key, matching the existing project.portability pattern

Live review runs demonstrate the criterion fires reliably at validity 1.0 on hand-enumerated plans, naming omitted files including string-literal monkeypatch sites that find_referencing_symbols cannot resolve
The overlay controls move applicability deterministically; coach LLM controls selection, and detection is largely redundant with existing blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 that fire on the same evidence
